title: I made an addictive little marble racing game, just got approved for iOS!
author: javiergame4
selftext:
Hey everyone!  
My new game, **Holy Marbles**, just got approved and is officially live on the iOS App Store! 🎉

It’s a multiplayer marble racing game where you can compete against other players, challenge your friends, and even build your own tracks!

Here’s what you can do:

🏁 **Race online with up to 8 players** — Compete against other players and see who can make it to the finish line first.

🛠️** Build your own track**s — There’s a full level editor where you can create your own maps and race on them.  
👥 **Play with friends** — Add friends, create private matches, and race together.

🎮 **Quick, chaotic races** — Easy to pick up and play, but mastering the tracks is a different story lol.

I built the game in Unity and used **Claude Sonnet 5.5** for pretty much the entire development process, from coding and implementing features to debugging and polishing everything. Used some free assets online I found too. 

It’s honestly pretty crazy how far these tools have come. There’s still a ton of testing, tweaking, and fixing involved, but being able to build and actually ship something like this has been a really fun experience.

I’m planning to keep improving the game, adding more content, and building on player feedback.

If you enjoy multiplayer racing games or creating your own levels, I’d really appreciate you checking it out!

📱 **Holy Marbles is available now on iOS!**

**App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/holy-marbles/id6826104233

Would love to hear what you guys think, especially about the multiplayer and level editor. Any feedback is appreciated!

replies.body:
You are not much fun at parties are you? It’s obviously a word that is used in marketing. The creator just wanted to use it. As they stated, it’s subjective, and the reason he used it was just to be catchy aka for “marketing”.
